title: events.rs: unbounded SSE delivery channel allows memory growth on slow clients
description: events_handler creates a tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel to bridge the coalescing task to the SSE stream. The coalescing task calls live_tx.send() and only stops when the receiver is dropped (client disconnects). A slow or stalled SSE consumer (e.g. a mobile client that suspends) does not drop the receiver, so the unbounded channel accumulates events without bound. In practice the broadcast ring (capacity 64) limits bursts, but a steady trickle of state changes against a stalled client can grow the mpsc queue indefinitely. Fix: use a bounded channel (e.g. capacity 16) and drop slow clients when the channel is full.
